name: Customer.io
tagline: Behavioral messaging platform REST API for people, events, and transactional messages
description: Customer.io provides REST APIs for managing people (customers), tracking events, and sending transactional messages across channels. Developers use site ID and API key (or App API keys) to identify users, trigger campaigns, and deliver personalized messages from backend systems.

auth.details: Track API uses Basic auth: site_id as username, API key as password (or Bearer). App API uses Bearer token with app API key. Region-specific hosts (US/EU).

use_cases: identify or update a person by ID
track a custom event for a user
send a transactional email or message
delete a person from the workspace
